entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us and may be recorded for quality and training purposes.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item.
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
Mark Smith. Order number is VF90210.
Thank you, Mark. I see your order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered 8 days ago. To proceed, could you tell me, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?
It's the color. It's not what I expected. The box is unopened, so it should be simple.
I understand. Sometimes the lighting in photos can make a color appear differently. I see here that you're well within the 90-day return window for this item.
So you can process the return?

Absolutely. We want to ensure you have gear you love, especially when it comes to something as important as a helmet where both comfort and safety are key. I've just initiated the return for you in our system.
Fine. What do I do now?

I'm sending an email to the address on file right now. It will contain a prepaid return shipping label and instructions. Just attach that to the box and drop it off at any designated shipping center. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund.
Whatever. As long as it's handled.
It is. You should see that email within the next 5 minutes. Was there anything else I could assist you with today, Mark?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can get you into the right gear soon. Have a good rest of your day.
